beliefs: f removes all Unicode whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines, NBSP, EM SPACE, etc.) from the input [E1, E14, E15, E16, E17]
f shifts only the first character of the whitespace-stripped string forward by 2 in the alphabet, wrapping at the end, for any letter (ASCII or non-ASCII) [E1, E4, E14, E18]

The shift uses Unicode code-point arithmetic: chr(ord(first)+2) with wrap only for ASCII a-z/A-Z; non-ASCII letters shift by +2 code points without wrapping [E18: 'é'->'ë', 'ü'->'þ', 'À'->'Â', 'α'->'γ', 'Ж'->'И']
All characters after the first pass through unchanged [E4, E14]
Digits and punctuation pass through unchanged, and a non-letter first character is not shifted [E1, E11]
The empty string (or all-whitespace string) maps to the empty string [E1, E14]
Case is preserved on the shifted first letter [E1, E14]
